title: Inside the mech the hull takes every hit and the pilot rides along
intent: Give the mech separate health without a second player object or new targeting logic

attempts.approach: eject the pilot at the mech's centre
attempts.failureReason: the wreck drew over them at the same depth, so after an explosion the player could not see themselves

evidence.description: Giant slam 35, debris 25, charge 40 on the hull with the pilot at 100; wrecked by a slam, pilot thrown clear at full health

constraints.statement: Exactly one Player per run; piloting hides it, disables its body and carries it at the mech's position, so enemies, the flow field, spawns and the Giant all target the mech unchanged
Every hit still goes through ArenaScene.damagePlayer, which routes to damageMech while piloting; the Giant's slam, charge and debris therefore land on the hull
The pilot leaves only through syncPilot and ejectPilot - beside the hatch on open ground away from the danger, health as it was, untouchable 1.5 s, nearby enemies shoved
A powered-down mech draws under the player (depth 2.8) and has no body; only a piloted mech collides
